# Venice
country_event = {
	id = cosmo_brothel_events.2
	title = cosmo_brothel_events.2.t
	desc = cosmo_brothel_events.2.d
	picture = cosmogfx_BROTHEL_VENICE_eventPictures
		
	is_triggered_only = yes
	
	trigger = {
		ai = no	
	NOT = {
		has_country_flag = venice_has_prostitutes
		}
		check_variable = {
			which = cosmoDegeneracyVariable
			value = 100
			}
		any_owned_province = {
			same_continent = CAPITAL
			province_has_center_of_trade_of_level = 2
			trade_goods = prostitutes 			 
			}
		VEN = {
		ai = yes
		any_owned_province = {
			same_continent = CAPITAL
			province_has_center_of_trade_of_level = 1
			NOT = {
			trade_goods = prostitutes
			has_province_flag = cosmo_no_prostitutes 			 
			}			
		}		
		}
	}
	mean_time_to_happen = {
		days = 60
	}

	option = {			# We will exploit this!
		name = cosmo_brothel_events.2.a
		set_country_flag = venice_has_prostitutes		
			112 = {
		change_trade_goods = prostitutes 
		add_province_modifier = { 
			name = cosmo_venetian_brothels
			duration = -1  
			desc = cosmo_venetian_brothels_DESC

		}
				add_trade_modifier = {
			who = VEN
			duration = -1
			power = 20
			key = STRONG_MERCHANTS
		}	
		}
			108 = {
		change_trade_goods = prostitutes 
		add_province_modifier = { 
			name = cosmo_venetian_brothels
			duration = -1  
			desc = cosmo_venetian_brothels_DESC

		}
	}		
	}
}

				OR = {
						culture_group = altaic

						culture_group = tartar				
				}
				has_building = brothel_district
			}
			}			
		}
		NOT = {
			has_country_flag = no_prostitutes_in_steppes
			has_country_flag = steppe_muslim_brothels

			has_country_flag = steppe_korea_brothels

		}
